mapper.sql:

AND (name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR email ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR department ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select:

mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET name = #{req.name}, gender = #{req.gender}, age = #{req.age}, birthplace = #{req.birthplace}, join_date = #{req.joinDate}, department = #{req.department}, position = #{req.position}, image_url = #{req.image}, bio = #{req.bio}, hobby = #{req.hobby}, self_qa = #{req.selfQa}, is_system_admin = #{req.isSystemAdmin}, is_hr_admin = #{req.isHrAdmin}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_delete = FALSE
mapper.select: INSERT INTO employee (name, email, cognito_sub, department, position, join_date, is_system_admin, is_hr_admin) VALUES (#{req.name}, #{req.email}, #{cognitoSub}, #{req.department}, #{req.position}, #{req.joinDate}, #{req.isSystemAdmin}, #{req.isHrAdmin}) RETURNING id
